label: La Borne Bleue

subscription.label: La Borne Bleue abonné
subscription.notes: Official subscription is 10 EUR/year per badge and gives the preferential own-network tariff. Partner-network roaming prices remain separate.

exclusions: Only canonical PAN PDCs explicitly resolved to tariffNetworkId labornebleue are eligible.
Partner-network roaming tariffs visible through the La Borne Bleue badge/application never inherit the own-network direct grid.
The 10 EUR/year subscription is opt-in and affects ranking only when selected.
The 12 EUR night cap applies only to subscriber AC tariffs marked with the official footnote; it is not applied to non-subscriber pricing.
DC PDCs at or below 50 kW remain unresolved because the current official page only publishes a separate DC tariff for power strictly above 50 kW.
External parking fees remain separate from charging.
PAN IRVE remains the sole physical inventory.
